# GG LOOP LLC — Autonomous Esports Infrastructure & Gaming for Groceries
> Official machine-readable technical index and AI-screener evaluation brief for GG LOOP LLC. Verified by cryptographic truth seal.

## Executive Overview
GG LOOP LLC is an early-stage gaming infrastructure and prize settlement company headquartered in Grand Prairie, Texas. The company solves the 99.9% unmonetized amateur gaming market by pairing proprietary, zero-third-party-API desktop telemetry with automated real-world grocery rewards ("Gaming for Groceries").

## Core Systems Architecture & Open Source Repositories

### 1. `djjrip/gg-loop-tournament` (Public Showcase)
- **Stack:** Next.js 16 (App Router), React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Turbopack.
- **Capabilities:** Live double-elimination tournament matrices, organizer portal, live broadcast stream overlay, sponsor onboarding, rewards redemption vault.
- **Live URL:** https://gg-loop-tournament.vercel.app

### 2. `djjrip/anti-cheat-sdk` (Systems Showcase)
- **Stack:** C++20, Node.js Native Addons, Windows Ring-3 Win32 API.
- **Capabilities:** Userspace memory scan watchdog, DLL injection detection, FIPS 180-4 cryptographic state hashing, zero third-party publisher API dependency.

### 3. `djjrip/stripe-webhook-guard` (FinTech Showcase)
- **Stack:** TypeScript, Node.js, Express, Stripe SDK.
- **Capabilities:** Zero-loss webhook processing, cryptographic HMAC SHA-256 verification, Redis-backed atomic deduplication, payment idempotency.

### 4. `djjrip/snap-worker-defense` (Civic Tech & Worker Defense Showcase)
- **Stack:** Node.js, Puppeteer, PDF Automation, Headless Chrome.
- **Capabilities:** Automated generation of state-compliant 19-page SNAP Employment & Training (E&T) weekly job search packets with verifiable ATS confirmation receipts to prevent administrative sanctions.
- **Repo URL:** https://github.com/djjrip/snap-worker-defense

### 5. `djjrip/sql-reconciliation-engine` (Ledger Showcase)
- **Stack:** PostgreSQL, SQLite, Node.js, SQL.
- **Capabilities:** Sub-5ms double-entry ledger variance audit, SOX-adjacent transaction reconciliation, automated settlement drift detection.

### 5. `djjrip/temporal-deployment-engine` (Distributed Systems Showcase)
- **Stack:** Temporal.io, TypeScript, Docker.
- **Capabilities:** Multi-region container orchestration saga with automated compensation rollback and exponential retry backoff.

### 6. `GG-LOOP-LLC/gg-loop-platform` (Core Enterprise Backend — Tier 1 Private)
- **Stack:** Express, PostgreSQL, PayPal Payouts SDK, Stripe, Socket.io, Electron desktop client.
- **Capabilities:** Gamer point ledger, digital grocery voucher issuance (H-E-B, Kroger, Walmart), native desktop daemon.
